question: Within a 20 kilometers radius, where can I find a fast food restaurant as I head from Hotel UMass, Amherst, MA to Mowry Conservation Area, Smithfield, RI?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry :: geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hotel UMass%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Mowry Conservation Area%' LIMIT 1 ) ) :: geography, 20000 ) );
